I posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message, addressed to you:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. Use the new name for this account.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so the acronym alone is ambiguous.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label changed to Pellow Home Living, so the supervisor search stops returning the old name.
- Ask: update the saved report label and check the next export for the old name.

I didn't draft or send anything to June. The bullets came from the coverage notes and the February channel history, which I checked through the brain. The brain search runs keyword-only, so it may have missed related material.
